dedupe_keys.name: extreme climate loss dataset of hainan island

description: Chenyang Yuan and colleagues publish modelled economic losses from drought, heatwaves and heavy rain across Hainan Island, China. The September 2025 deposit covers 1970–2020 at monthly intervals on a one-kilometre grid. A nonlinear loss model combines GDP, weather and land-use information, with calibration against Chinese disaster and reservoir-management records. NetCDF outputs are distributed in a ZIP archive, free under CC BY 4.0. The estimates are expressed in Chinese yuan and can provide regional loss scenarios or comparison targets for climate-impact simulations. The price base, uncertainty intervals and share attributable specifically to infrastructure remain unknown from the metadata. These are estimated losses, not a direct inventory of damaged assets. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this Hainan collection. The provider reports calibration performance, but numerical results and files were not independently checked.
